name: card-3d
title: Card 3D
blurb: Card elements tilt in 3D response to cursor, with stacked depth layers.
description: Composite card system: CardContainer tracks mouse and applies rotateY/X; CardBody is the card frame; CardItem elements translate on the Z-axis based on hover. Uses CSS perspective and 3D transforms. Similar to 3d-card but from…
use_when: Hero cards or feature showcases where layered 3D depth creates visual interest.
avoid_when: Touch devices or low-motion preferences — 3D transforms are mouse-only.
a11y: No keyboard navigation for 3D effects. Content is readable.
